title: Network disruption in post-stroke depressive symptoms: a Bayesian multicohort study
title_zh: 网络破坏在中风后抑郁症状中的作用：一个贝叶斯多中心研究
abstract: Abstract Post-stroke depressive symptoms are common, but studies on the contributions of lesion locations to depression symptoms remain inconsistent. Bayesian statistics offer the possibility to clarify these inconsistencies by providing evidence in favor and against observed associations. We reanalyzed four previously published observational cohorts with 1,864 patients with stroke characterized for depressive symptoms from France, Korea, Germany and the USA. We performed voxel-wise Bayes factor mapping using general linear models. Lesion maps were used to test for associations of post-stroke depressive symptoms with lesion location. Network level associations were tested based on structural disconnection and functional lesion network maps estimated by reference to normative connectome data. Due to a sample size with broad lesion coverage, Bayesian inference was informative in large parts of the brain. Lesion associations were found in clusters in the right hemisphere including cortical (frontal, insular, parietal) and subcortical regions (striatum, amygdala, hippocampus) and adjacent white matter. Evidence of no contribution to post-stroke depressive symptoms was observed in large parts of the left hemisphere. Structural disconnection was linked to depressive symptoms in the bilateral frontal white matter prominently involving the corpus callosum and anterior thalamic radiation. Lesion network mapping revealed evidence of an association of post-stroke depressive symptoms with network connectivity in the left posterior cingulate cortex and precuneus, and less consistently, the bilateral anterior insula, along with widespread absence of associations in other regions. Depressive symptoms were most strongly associated with right frontal lesions and right-dominant structural disconnection in frontal cortico-subcortical circuits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 中风后抑郁症状很常见，但关于病灶位置对抑郁症状贡献的研究结果仍不一致。贝叶斯统计有可能通过提供支持和反对观察到关联的证据来阐明这些不一致之处。我们重新分析了四篇先前发表的观察性队列，这些队列包括来自法国、韩国、德国和美国的1,864名中风患者，已评估其抑郁症状。我们使用广义线性模型进行了体素级别的贝叶斯因子映射。利用病灶图谱测试中风后抑郁症状与病灶位置的关联。基于结构断连和参考规范连接组数据估计的功能病灶网络图，测试了网络级别的关联。由于样本量广泛覆盖了大脑，贝叶斯推断在大脑的大部分区域均具有信息量。在右半球发现了病灶关联，包括皮质区域（前叶、岛叶、顶叶）和亚皮质区域（纹状体、杏仁核、海马体）以及相邻的白质。在大脑左半球的广大区域观察到对中风后抑郁症状没有贡献的证据。双侧前部白质的结构断连与抑郁症状相关，特别是涉及胼胝体和前额叶辐射。病灶网络映射揭示了中风后抑郁症状与左后扣带回和旁叶网络连接性的关联证据，以及双侧前岛叶的较不一致的关联，以及其他区域广泛缺乏关联。抑郁症状与右前叶病灶以及右侧主导的前额叶-亚皮质电路结构断连最为密切相关。
